editorial.text: I was really sorry to read about the potential closure of Hove Library. This was the site of one of the most famous campaigns against closure back in 2003/4 where five thousand people put up “save the library” posters and it made national news. The plan is for Hove to move into a museum and two other libraries to move into a school and a children’s centre. They’re not closing as such so the public response is likely to be muted. We’ll see how muted in the next few weeks.
